_comment: Shared test corpus for compliance/shape validators. Keyed by DataShape enum name; each shape maps to a list of {input, expected} cases asserting that the validator returns `expected` for `input` (input null = the absent value). Cases are language-independent; the Scala (ShapesSuite.scala), Java (ShapesTest.java), and Python (shapes_test.py) suites all load this file and run every case. Add a shape or case once here and all three languages pick it up. See compliance/shape/README.md for the design rationale. Note: DATA_SHAPE_NUMERIC intentionally omits a null case — Scala's Numeric validator does not guard against null (it would NPE), while Python's _NumericValidator returns DATA_NOT_MATCHES_SHAPE; the corpus encodes only behavior the two languages share.
